title: Motorola Solutions to Issue Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on November 4
summary: Webcast presentation by executives to follow earnings release
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO – October 19, 2026** – Motorola Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: MSI) will issue its third-quarter 2026 earnings results after the close of the market on Wednesday, November 4.


Motorola Solutions will host its quarterly conference call with financial analysts at 4 p.m. Central (5 p.m. Eastern) on November 4. The conference call will be webcast live at[www.motorolasolutions.com/investors](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/investors) .


**About Motorola Solutions | Solving for safer** Safety and security are at the heart of everything we do at Motorola Solutions. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Learn more about our commitment to innovating for a safer future for us all at[www.motorolasolutions.com](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/) .
